title: Questions and Answers — Tenure Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Quarterly Purchase Allowance, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A long-held Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding gets a tenure tolerance on the quarter's purchase allowance.

## The rule

The quarter-limit tenure tolerance rests on the holding's age: a holding issued at least 120 whole months before today gets USD 7500; at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months gets USD 3000; a younger holding gets none.

The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the quarter's purchase allowance before the excess is taken.

## Questions answered

**How is the holding's age measured?** In whole months from its issue date to today.

**What does a holding issued 96 whole months ago get?** USD 3000.

**And one issued 120 whole months ago?** USD 7500; at 119 whole months it gets USD 3000.

**And one issued 59 whole months ago?** None.

| Age of the holding | Tenure tolerance |
|---|---|
| 120 whole months or more | USD 7500 |
| 60 to 119 whole months | USD 3000 |
| Fewer than 60 whole months | None |
